hypothesis: A useful ONNX(온엑스) must keep positive expectancy after broker-like cost stress, not only at zero extra cost.
decision_use: future candidate hard gate(하드 게이트) and failure memory comparison
control_variables: model family, feature order, split rules, MT5 authority, fixed risk accounting
changed_variables: feature thesis and training packet may change only in future predeclared runs
sample_scope: US100 M5, post-2026-04-14 forward evidence plus later WFO(워크포워드) slices
success_criteria: positive net and acceptable PF(수익 팩터) under predeclared cost ladder including +1.0 and +2.0
failure_criteria: positive headline net disappears under +1.0 cost or expectancy is concentrated in one pocket
invalid_conditions: cost ladder, spread, commission, or slippage assumption is changed after seeing forward result
stop_conditions: stop or downgrade if cost survival depends on threshold retune(임계값 재조정) or lot optimization(로트 최적화)
source_contract_question: Can the surface survive at least extra_cost_per_trade=1.0 without threshold or lot tuning?

hypothesis: Long and short sides must be measured as paired evidence before a side limit is trusted.
decision_use: branch design and future selection guard
comparison_baseline: run336O repaired subset: 3/4 non-positive short net
control_variables: no post-forward side dropping; side logic predeclared
changed_variables: future signal thesis may introduce side-specific features only before forward evaluation
sample_scope: long/short attribution on Tier A(티어 A), Tier B(티어 B), and routed total
success_criteria: both sides contribute or an explicit pre-forward side thesis passes negative controls
failure_criteria: short side is removed after seeing forward loss, or one side hides total drawdown
invalid_conditions: side rule references forward loss bucket, month, hour, or attempt outcome
stop_conditions: stop if side-specific gain cannot be reproduced in MT5 runtime probe(런타임 탐침)
source_contract_question: Can long and short both contribute or be predeclared with honest side limits?

hypothesis: The equity curve must avoid deep rolling pockets and long underwater stretches, not just finish positive.
comparison_baseline: run336O: rolling20 worst net <= -50 in 4/4 attempts
control_variables: same rolling windows and drawdown definitions across Python and MT5
changed_variables: future objective may include predeclared curve penalty, but no forward pocket filtering
sample_scope: rolling 20/50/100 trades, underwater stretch, recovery factor, month/session pockets
success_criteria: no broken rolling pocket, recovery factor and DD(낙폭) survive cost stress together
failure_criteria: single final net hides rolling-window break or underwater concentration
invalid_conditions: calendar/session/month exclusions are chosen from the failed forward pocket
stop_conditions: stop if the curve improves only by lowering trade count below target density
source_contract_question: Can the curve avoid deep rolling pockets and long underwater stretches?

hypothesis: Regime slices should explain weakness without becoming post-hoc exclusion filters.
decision_use: regime attribution(국면 귀속) and economic clue routing
comparison_baseline: run336O worst slice: u42_bal_rf us10yr_change_flat net=-118.94
control_variables: slice definitions fixed before new candidate scoring
changed_variables: future feature families may include predeclared macro/rate/volatility interactions
sample_scope: session, hour, month, volatility, ADX, VIX, USD, rate regime slices
success_criteria: no slice is a single catastrophic source of the whole curve
failure_criteria: candidate survives only by deleting a known forward-bad slice
invalid_conditions: rate/volatility regime filter is selected from run336O forward loss
stop_conditions: stop if economic indicator alignment uses future publication or same-bar unavailable data
source_contract_question: Can volatility, ADX, VIX, USD, and rate slices explain survival without post-hoc filters?

hypothesis: Proxy expected values can sanity-check signals only after comparison with MT5 runtime results.
comparison_baseline: run336N parity matched 20/20 but proxy profit is not KPI authority
changed_variables: future proxy templates may change only to mirror runtime handoff before scoring
sample_scope: each branch must output proxy expected values and MT5 runtime probe values
success_criteria: row-level signal differences are measured and labeled usable/not_usable/context_only
failure_criteria: proxy result is used as profit pass/fail without MT5 runtime probe
invalid_conditions: raw timestamp mismatch is reused without aligned basis
stop_conditions: stop if proxy and MT5 disagree on direction or feature readiness at row grain
source_contract_question: Can proxy expected values remain signal checks while MT5 keeps KPI authority?
source_required_evidence: proxy expected vs MT5 runtime probe difference;usability label

hypothesis: Full-family claims require fresh timestamp-safe feature handoff for core56 as well as macro48/u42.
comparison_baseline: core56 excluded from repaired subset until equity/breadth/top3 refresh is repaired
control_variables: no full cp322A family claim from macro48/u42 subset only
changed_variables: future data refresh source may be repaired, then parity-probed before any model use
sample_scope: core56 equity, breadth, top3 features, macro48, u42 runtime handoff
success_criteria: feature freshness and timestamp basis pass before full-family report
failure_criteria: core56 is silently dropped while claiming family robustness
invalid_conditions: external equity/breadth source uses future bars or stale last value without audit
stop_conditions: stop if core56 repair cannot prove no lookahead and broker-session alignment
source_contract_question: Can feature handoff stay fresh and timestamp-safe across all required families?
source_required_evidence: feature freshness audit;timestamp basis audit;core56 refresh repair condition

hypothesis: New research must prove feature-label boundary before any profitable result is interpreted.
comparison_baseline: prior work showed split-local and same-bar risks must not return
control_variables: no future bars, no forward-result-selected threshold, no after-result feature pick
changed_variables: only predeclared experiment variables may change
sample_scope: all Stage337 branches, datasets, labels, joins, and runtime handoff
success_criteria: as-of joins and label boundaries are documented and testable
failure_criteria: any feature, rule, or filter reads future outcome or forward result
invalid_conditions: candidate is repaired after failed forward without a new predeclared packet
stop_conditions: stop and mark invalid if lookahead canary passes as if it were legitimate
source_contract_question: Can all new designs prove feature-label boundary and avoid forward pocket fitting?

hypothesis: The target ONNX(온엑스) must eventually combine high profit, smooth curve, density, and no broken KPI.
decision_use: future operating-worthy research target, not a current claim
comparison_baseline: run336O had density but not cost/curve robustness
control_variables: operating claims remain forbidden until independent MT5 evidence exists
changed_variables: future objective can search stronger signals, but must pass all defensive gates
sample_scope: multi-horizon OOS(표본외), forward, MT5, cost stress, lot-normalized evidence
success_criteria: profit, PF, DD, recovery, expectancy, trade density, and regime slices survive together
failure_criteria: one headline metric is great while curve, DD, side, or cost breaks
invalid_conditions: explosive net is created by leverage, lot, or threshold cosmetics
stop_conditions: stop if any core KPI is broken, even with high net profit
